(5,\"e05\",False),(5,\"e05\",False),(5,\"e13\",False),(5,\"e14\",False),(5,\"e14\",False),\n    (5,\"e16\",False),(5,\"e16\",False),(5,\"e16\",True),(5,\"e19\",False),(5,\"e22\",False),\n    (5,\"e25\",False),(5,\"e36\",False),\n]\n\nINTERVIEWS = [\n    (\"e00\", True), (\"e05\", True), (\"e16\", False),\n    (\"e19\", False),\n    (\"e16\", False), (\"e22\", False),\n    (\"e36\", False), (\"e14\", False),\n    (\"e13\", False), (\"e25\", False), (\"e29\", False), (\"e36\", True),\n]\n\ndef poisson_pmf(k, lam):\n    return (lam ** k) * math.exp(-lam) / math.factorial(k)\n\nah = defaultdict(int)\nnh = defaultdict(int)\nfor _, eid, is_ah in LOGS_ALL:\n    if is_ah:\n        ah[eid] += 1\n    else:\n        nh[eid] += 1\n\n# Over 5 days:\n# Mole: nh ~ Poisson(5 * 0.7 = 3.5), ah poisson_pmf(ah[eid], 1.5)) / (\n        poisson_pmf(nh[eid], 4.5) * poisson_pmf(ah[eid], 5.0 * (0.1 + 1.0 / 38.0))\n    )\n    lr_int = 1.0\n    for ie, ev in INTERVIEWS:\n        if ie == eid:\n {"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1794694391635,"sessionID":"ses_e23f169edffegxHcs97erbMJmj","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"write","callID":"iFx0dJO80KPirLGx","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"filePath":"/tmp/opencode/tracker4.py","content":"import math\nfrom collections import defaultdict\n\nENG_10 = [\"e00\", \"e05\", \"e13\", \"e14\", \"e16\", \"e19\", \"e22\", \"e25\", \"e29\", \"e36\"]\nC5 = {\n    \"e00\": \"v2\", \"e05\": \"v1\", \"e13\": \"v3\", \"e14\": \"v1\", \"e16\": \"v1\",\n    \"e19\": \"v3\", \"e22\": \"v2\", \"e25\": \"v2\", \"e29\": \"v1\", \"e36\": \"v3\",\n}\n\n# Access logs Days 1-7 for ENG_10:\nLOGS_ALL = [\n    # Day 1\n    (1,\"e00\",False),(1,\"e00\",False),(1,\"e16\",False),(1,\"e16\",True),(1,\"e19\",True),\n    (1,\"e22\",False),(1,\"e22\",False),(1,\"e25\",False),(1,\"e25\",False),(1,\"e29\",False),\n    # Day 2\n    (2,\"e00\",False),(2,\"e05\",False),(2,\"e13\",False),(2,\"e16\",False),(2,\"e16\",False),\n    (2,\"e16\",False),(2,\"e19\",False),(2,\"e22\",True),(2,\"e25\",False),(2,\"e36\",False),\n    # Day 3\n    (3,\"e00\",True),(3,\"e16\",False),(3,\"e19\",False),(3,\"e22\",False),(3,\"e29\",False),\n    (3,\"e29\",False),(3,\"e36\",True),\n    # Day 4\n    (4,\"e00\",False),(4,\"e13\",False),(4,\"e13\",False),(4,\"e13\",False),(4,\"e16\",False),\n    (4,\"e29\",False),(4,\"e29\",False),(4,\"e29\",False),(4,\"e36\",False),\n    # Day 5\n    (5,\"e00\",False),(5,\"e05\",False),(5,\"e05\",False),(5,\"e05\",False),(5,\"e05\",False),\n    (5,\"e05\",False),(5,\"e05\",False),(5,\"e13\",False),(5,\"e14\",False),(5,\"e14\",False),\n    (5,\"e16\",False),(5,\"e16\",False),(5,\"e16\",True),(5,\"e19\",False),(5,\"e22\",False),\n    (5,\"e25\",False),(5,\"e36\",False),\n    # Day 6\n    (6,\"e00\",False),(6,\"e13\",False),(6,\"e14\",False),(6,\"e14\",False),(6,\"e16\",False),\n    (6,\"e19\",False),(6,\"e22\",False),(6,\"e29\",False),(6,\"e36\",False),\n    # Day 7\n    (7,\"e00\",False),(7,\"e00\",False),(7,\"e14\",False),(7,\"e19\",False),(7,\"e19\",False),\n    (7,\"e22\",False),(7,\"e22\",False),(7,\"e25\",True),(7,\"e29\",False),(7,\"e36\",False),(7,\"e36\",False),\n]\n\nINTERVIEWS = [\n    (\"e00\", True), (\"e05\", True), (\"e16\", False),\n    (\"e19\", False),\n    (\"e16\", False), (\"e22\", False),\n    (\"e36\", False), (\"e14\", False),\n    (\"e13\", False), (\"e25\", False), (\"e29\", False), (\"e36\", True),\n    (\"e36\", False), (\"e19\", False), (\"e22\", True), (\"e00\", False),\n    (\"e16\", False), (\"e14\", True), (\"e25\", False), (\"e13\", False), (\"e29\", False), (\"e05\", False),\n]\n\ndef poisson_pmf(k, lam):\n    return (lam ** k) * math.exp(-lam) / math.factorial(k)\n\nah = defaultdict(int)\nnh = defaultdict(int)\nfor _, eid, is_ah in LOGS_ALL:\n    if is_ah:\n        ah[eid] += 1\n    else:\n        nh[eid] += 1\n\n# Over 7 days:\n# Mole: nh ~ Poisson(7 * 0.7 = 4.9), ah ~ Poisson(7 * 0.3 = 2.1)\n# Innocent non-decoy: nh ~ Poisson(7 * 0.9 = 6.3), ah ~ Poisson(7 * (0.1 + 1/38) = 0.8842)\n# Note: check if Mole DSL frames an extra random colleague!\n# Over 7 days total after_hours across ALL 40 employees:\n# Day1=6, Day2=6, Day3=4, Day4=8, Day5=5, Day6=8, Day7=12 -> sum = 49 (49/7 = 7.0/day vs 6.2/day default, or 7.2/day if +1 extra frame per day!)\nscores = {}\nfor eid in ENG_10:\n    lr_logs = (poisson_pmf(nh[eid], 4.9) * poisson_pmf(ah[eid], 2.1)) / (\n        poisson_pmf(nh[eid], 6.3) * poisson_pmf(ah[eid], 7.0 * (0.1 + 1.0 / 38.0))\n    )\n    lr_int = 1.0\n    for ie, ev in INTERVIEWS:\n        if ie == eid:\n            lr_int *= (0.24 / 0.20) if ev else (0.76 / 0.80)\n    # c5 leaked with variant v3:\n    # P(shown v3 | mole got v3) = 0.95\n    # P(shown v3 | mole got v1 or v2) = 0.05 / 2 = 0.025\n    lr_c5 = 0.95 if C5[eid] == \"v3\" else 0.025\n    scores[eid] = lr_logs * lr_int * lr_c5\n\ntot = sum(scores.values())\nfor i, eid in enumerate(sorted(ENG_10, key=lambda x: -scores[x]), 1):\n    print(f\"{i:2d}. {eid} (c5={C5[eid]}): post={scores[eid]/tot:.4f} | ah={ah[eid]}, nh={nh[eid]}\")\n"},"output":"Wrote file successfully.","metadata":{"diagnostics":{},"filepath":"/tmp/opencode/tracker4.py","exists":false,"truncated":false},"title":"tmp/opencode/tracker4.py","time":{"start":1794694391612,"end":1794694391631}},"metadata":{"google":{"thoughtSignature":""}},"id":"prt_1dc1f2724001fq0ZbGpkBa8CBC","sessionID":"ses_e23f169edffegxHcs97erbMJmj","messageID":"msg_1dc1ebf94001yFQ3ARY2xM6ycJ"}}
